sections.en: There is a significant amount of debris in orbit around this gas giant. Most of it appears to come from long lost starships of various configurations.

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]周围的无数废弃舰船中，我们发现了一艘几乎完好无损的外星科研船。船上的记录揭示，它发生了严重设备故障，在虚空中漂流了142天后，其船员因缺乏营养而逝世。

我们在一张小床上发现了舰长遗骸，他手中握着一颗金属小方块，每一面都有不同的颜色，并分成九个大小相同的可旋转方块。科学专员[Root.Owner.GetScientist][cube_science_officer.GetName]相信，当旋转到正确的图案时，方块将会开启，并揭露隐藏的宝藏。
texts.en:
Among the husks of the derelict starships orbiting [From.GetName] we have discovered an almost intact alien research vessel. The ship's logs reveal that it suffered a critical hardware malfunction and was stuck in limbo for 142 days before the crew perished from malnutrition.

The body of the Captain was found on his cot clutching a small metal cube, each side a different color and split into nine equal rotatable squares. [Root.Owner.GetScientist] [cube_science_officer.GetName] is convinced that when rotated in the correct pattern the cube will open to reveal a hidden treasure.

texts.zh: 我们发现了一颗金属小方块，每一面都有不同的颜色，令科学专员[cube_science_officer.GetName]大感困惑，认为它里面一定藏着什么有价值的东西。
texts.en: The discovery of a tiny metal cube with different colored sides has mystified Science Officer [cube_science_officer.GetName], who is certain it hides something of value inside.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]的船员们尝试了各种解码算法来对付那金属方块，但都没有任何反应。

“它是不是个密码？隐藏着宝贵物品的容器？”“如果这个方块没有意义，那什么才有意义？”科学专员[cube_science_officer.GetName]疲惫不堪的头脑中闪过了这些念头，最后[cube_science_officer.GetSheHe]终于使出了激光切割这一招，同时也不慎将[cube_science_officer.GetHerHis]的右[From.Owner.GetSpeciesHandName]切成了两半。方块里空空如也。
texts.en:
The crew on the [From.GetName] has subjected the metal cube to every code breaking algorithm known to us and it has responded with nothing but silence.

"Is it a cipher? A container for valuable items?" "If there is no meaning behind this cube, what then is the meaning of anything?" were some of the thoughts that scurried through the overworked mind of Science Officer [cube_science_officer.GetName] when [cube_science_officer.GetSheHe] finally brought out the laser and sliced first the cube, then [cube_science_officer.GetHerHis] right [From.Owner.GetSpeciesHandName] in half. The cube was empty.

tooltips.en: [cube_science_officer.GetName] will never be the same again.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]的强重力井将大量的太空垃圾吸了进来，在气态巨行星一边形成了一圈致密的金属层。这些东西的大部分应该是数千年前星系里发生的太空战役遗留下的残骸。现在有技术价值的残骸和文物已被拾荒者搜刮走了，但可以利用开采站来回收金属。
texts.en:
The strong gravity well of [From.GetName] has pulled in a massive amount of space debris which has formed a dense layer around parts of the gas giant. Most of it appears to be wreckage from a series of space battles fought in the system several millennia ago.

Scavengers have already scoured the debris of valuable technologies and artifacts, but a mining station should be able to recycle the metal.

summary.text:
# 太空碎片 / Space Debris

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（仅 distar.1055 分支 only the distar.1055 branch） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/00_anomaly_categories.txt:347; events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:2283 (distar.1055); common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt (THE_CUBE); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:2315 (distar.1056); events/anomaly_events_1.txt:4049 (anomaly.320)

## 如何开始 How it starts

没有战略资源的气态巨行星可能生成（1级，权重3）。

Can spawn on a gas giant without a strategic resource (level 1, weight 3).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

anomaly.320“残骸场”权重1：d_minerals_3 矿藏与 debris_field 修正。distar.1055“方块”基础权重0，仅当银河中存在人类（太阳系标志 com_sol / nuked_sol 或国家标志 human_1 / humans_early_space_age），且发现者不是人类预设帝国或人类物种时 +1：选项a启用项目 THE_CUBE（科学船+科学家，60天），完成后触发 distar.1056“切割”（科学官获得“狂躁”特质）；选项b放弃。

anomaly.320 "Debris Field" has weight 1: a d_minerals_3 deposit plus the debris_field modifier. distar.1055 "The Cube" has base weight 0 and +1 only if humans exist in the galaxy (system flag com_sol / nuked_sol or country flag human_1 / humans_early_space_age) and the finder is neither a human prescripted empire nor of the human species: option a enables project THE_CUBE (science ship and scientist, 60 days), whose completion fires distar.1056 "Slice and Dice" (the science officer gains the maniacal trait); option b declines.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

两个起始结果互斥；满足条件时各50%，否则只会得到 anomaly.320。

The two starting results are exclusive; 50% each when the condition holds, otherwise only anomaly.320.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

distar.1055 取决于银河中是否存在人类；发现者为人类时不会出现。

distar.1055 depends on humans existing in the galaxy; it cannot appear for human finders.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对。草稿将 distar.1055 显示为 p=0.00*（基础权重），实际取决于人类是否存在，已用互斥组说明。

Checked. The draft shows distar.1055 as p=0.00* (its base weight); the real weight depends on whether humans exist, documented with an exclusive group.
